issue.title: Catalog protocol-1 CLI test still expects 54 entries after themes split added entry 55
issue.description: Proposed by bob-cli-dd.3 note #1 during theme-rename byte-preservation work. On clean bob-cli 0421192684d525f556f44aa35a6e5ff61ef3660b, cargo test --test cli catalog::protocol_1_parses_with_schema_version_one -- --exact --nocapture fails at tests/cli/catalog.rs:42: actual 55, expected 54. Commit 0a896a45 (closed epic bob-cli-db) added themes-split to src/native/catalog/table.rs and updated src/native/catalog/tests.rs counts to 55, but missed this separate CLI assertion. The dd commit changes only rename.rs and themes_rename.rs. Update the CLI contract assertion to the intentional current catalog shape and verify the themes-split row plus protocol invariants, then run the focused catalog CLI suite and just check. This is a bounded stale test expectation, not a catalog feature or protocol version change. Same-type and all-type searches, last-week task sweeps, and all 11 in-progress epic descriptions found no semantic duplicate or credible active causal owner.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic 55-versus-54 assertion: source catalog and lib test deliberately contain 55 entries after 0a896a45, while the CLI test remains pinned to 54. Independently reproduced during landing; phase dd.3 also reproduced on its clean base.

issue.creation_reason: Phase bob-cli-dd.3 proposed this unrelated failure; the landing audit reproduced it and traced it to the already-closed bob-cli-db catalog addition.
